task_commit_basis: merge commit of the reference change (code after the optimization landed), from https://github.com/serilog/serilog/commit/dc529798b07de14d74393f33e388a51be9c610b2

reference_change.title: Inline TraceId and SpanId JSON string formatting

workload.source: written here from the description of https://github.com/serilog/serilog/pull/2215 (JsonFormatter): a .NET program that formats 20,000 events carrying trace and span ids to JSON (eval/tasks/workloads/serilog-serilog-pr2215-landed/EvalJson), copied into the tree, run on the tree where the change is already in

oracle.source: Serilog's JsonFormatter tests (JsonFormatterTests.cs is changed by https://github.com/serilog/serilog/pull/2215); targeted tests only

evidence.note: description: JsonFormatter writes the trace and span ids as quoted strings directly instead of through JsonValueFormatter.WriteQuotedJsonString (no timings in the description)

status_reason: built here and ran workload and oracle on the task and reference trees; see runs. Runs natively with the .NET SDK 10.0.402 that the eval user has in ~/.local/dotnet (docs/evaluation.md, T3.8), so the runtime gate identifies it. Under the sandbox profile MSBuild hung for ten minutes and then failed with no error with its default worker nodes and shared compiler server (the cause is not isolated, and neither is which of the three flags below is the one that matters; the same build takes about a second outside the profile), so every dotnet build and test here passes -m:1 -nodeReuse:false -p:UseSharedCompilation=false. NuGet packages come from the local feed ~/.local/dotnet/nuget-feed (a confined restore could not reach nuget.org: bad certificate format; the cause is inferred, not isolated)
